summary: The meeting discussed various customer-facing problems and needs for Q3, including POS outages during peak hours, mobile app search issues with out-of-stock items, pharmacy refill confusion, loyalty tier uncertainty, and store-associate handheld scanner limitations.

topics.summary: The POS system experiences frequent outages during peak hours, causing cashiers to lose internet access and resulting in lost revenue for the company.
topics.raw_quote: when the WAN drops, our POS goes fully offline — can't even process a cash sale because it can't validate the SKU pricing locally.
topics.speaker: Hiroshi

topics.summary: The mobile app search feature often returns out-of-stock items, leading to a negative customer experience and NPS scores.
topics.raw_quote: NPS for customers who hit this is -30. Customers who don't hit it are +18.
topics.speaker: Marcus

topics.summary: The pharmacy refill process is confusing due to the use of two separate systems, leading to issues with medication availability and customer satisfaction.
topics.raw_quote: It's because we have TWO refill flows: the in-app one, and the IVR phone line. They write to different systems and the systems don't reconcile in real time.
topics.speaker: Anika

topics.summary: Customers are unsure about how they earn or lose loyalty tier status, leading to frustration and confusion.
topics.raw_quote: The downgrade timing isn't clear from any customer-facing surface.
topics.speaker: Priya

topics.summary: The store-associate handheld scanners are outdated and lack modern features, causing issues with inventory management and customer satisfaction.
topics.raw_quote: The store-side handheld inventory scanners are running Android 7. They can't get security patches anymore.
topics.speaker: Hiroshi

constraints.statement: All payment authorization MUST go through the PaymentGateway service.

constraints.statement: Any feature that surfaces a medication name (push notifications, emails, SMS, in-app text) requires explicit patient opt-in stored on the prescription record.
constraints.source_excerpt: HIPAA. Any feature that surfaces a medication name (push notifications, emails, SMS, in-app text) requires: Explicit patient opt-in stored on the prescription record

constraints.statement: Card sales when the WAN is down: FORBIDDEN.
constraints.source_excerpt: Card sales when the WAN is down: FORBIDDEN.

constraints.statement: Mobile app cart-load p95 must stay under 1.5 seconds on a 3G connection.
constraints.source_excerpt: Mobile app cart-load p95 must stay under 1.5 seconds on a 3G connection.

constraints.statement: Direct calls to card processors are forbidden — this is a PCI scope requirement.
constraints.source_excerpt: All payment authorization MUST go through the PaymentGateway service. Direct calls to card processors are forbidden — this is a PCI scope requirement.

constraints.statement: All prescription-related operations MUST go through the Rx Hub service.
constraints.source_excerpt: All prescription-related operations MUST go through the Rx Hub service.

constraints.statement: Federation with NSID is the only supported pattern for customer identity.
constraints.source_excerpt: All customer identity must flow through NorthStar Identity (NSID). New auth flows MUST NOT introduce a separate customer credential store. Federation with NSID is the only supported pattern.
